================================================================================================================
PHASE 2 WARMUP PROBE
================================================================================================================

This probe measures structural state as historical context increases.
It does NOT determine the final warmup automatically.

  Warmup   Swings   Breaks   Class.    Zones   Liquidity   Time(s)              Trend
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      50        6        2        6        2           6     0.010      Trend.BULLISH
     100        9        4        9        4           9     0.010      Trend.BEARISH
     200       22       10       22       10          22     0.022      Trend.BULLISH
     300       31       14       31       14          31     0.026      Trend.BEARISH
     500       57       24       57       24          57     0.040      Trend.BEARISH
     750       78       33       78       33          78     0.056      Trend.BEARISH
    1000      100       39      100       39         100     0.070      Trend.BULLISH
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

STRUCTURAL OBSERVATIONS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  50 -> 100  candles | swings    6 -> 9    | breaks    2 -> 4    | zones    2 -> 4    | liquidity    6 -> 9    | TREND CHANGED: Trend.BULLISH -> Trend.BEARISH
 100 -> 200  candles | swings    9 -> 22   | breaks    4 -> 10   | zones    4 -> 10   | liquidity    9 -> 22   | TREND CHANGED: Trend.BEARISH -> Trend.BULLISH
 200 -> 300  candles | swings   22 -> 31   | breaks   10 -> 14   | zones   10 -> 14   | liquidity   22 -> 31   | TREND CHANGED: Trend.BULLISH -> Trend.BEARISH
 300 -> 500  candles | swings   31 -> 57   | breaks   14 -> 24   | zones   14 -> 24   | liquidity   31 -> 57  
 500 -> 750  candles | swings   57 -> 78   | breaks   24 -> 33   | zones   24 -> 33   | liquidity   57 -> 78  
 750 -> 1000 candles | swings   78 -> 100  | breaks   33 -> 39   | zones   33 -> 39   | liquidity   78 -> 100  | TREND CHANGED: Trend.BEARISH -> Trend.BULLISH

HOW TO INTERPRET THIS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Do not choose a warmup simply because it has the most swings, breaks, zones, or liquidity.
2. Look for candidate ranges where adding substantially more historical context produces progressively smaller structural changes.
3. A TREND CHANGED note between two consecutive candidates means the structural trend read is still unstable at that warmup size — treat that as evidence the smaller of the two is too little context, not as evidence the larger one is correct either.
4. Treat convergence as evidence for a candidate warmup, not proof that the candidate is optimal.
5. The final candidate must be tested with the canonical walk-forward engine.
6. Do not use trading performance from this probe to select the warmup. That would turn warmup selection into an optimization.

IMPORTANT
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This probe analyzes the FIRST n candles of the dataset.
That means it is a structural-context diagnostic, not yet a full fixed-evaluation warmup validation.
The walk-forward validation stage is still required before declaring a final warmup_size.

Total probe time across all 7 candidates: 0.234s — use this as a rough per-window cost reference before choosing run_walk_forward()'s window count.

NEXT STEP
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Run the probe, inspect the structural progression, choose reasonable candidate(s), then validate them with walk_forward.py.
